summary: Dot-matrix button with a pointer light and press ripples; `run(fn)` shows loading, success and error states around a promise.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Set to `danger` for the red colour scheme. Without it the accent colour is used. Read directly by CSS and the canvas, so changes apply on the next frame.

attributes.name: loading-text
attributes.description: Label shown while the promise passed to `run()` is pending.

attributes.name: success-text
attributes.description: Label shown for 1.7 s after the promise resolves.

attributes.name: error-text
attributes.description: Label shown for 1.7 s after the promise rejects.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Set to `submit` to call `requestSubmit()` on the owning form when clicked. Ignored when `demo` is set.

attributes.name: demo
attributes.description: Makes a click run a simulated 1.5 s task. `error` makes it fail; any other non-empty value makes it succeed.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Disables the inner button; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same.

events.name: start
events.description: Fires when `run()` enters the loading state.

events.name: success
events.description: Fires when the promise passed to `run()` resolves.

events.name: error
events.description: Fires when the promise passed to `run()` rejects.

methods.description: Shows the loading state while the promise runs, then success or error for 1.7 s before returning to the label. Resolves with the promise value and rethrows its error.

accessibility: Renders a native `<button type="button">` in the shadow root, so Enter and Space activate it.
The label sits in an `aria-live="polite"` region, so the loading, success and error text is announced.
Sets `aria-busy` on the inner button: `true` while loading, `false` otherwise.
Clicks during loading are stopped at the inner button and do not reach the host.
motion: With reduced motion the noise and loading fields are static, the label swaps without rolling, the error shake is skipped and the canvas redraws only on pointer movement or press.
form: Form-associated but submits no value of its own. With `type="submit"` a click calls `requestSubmit()` on the owning form.
notes: The label is the element's text content (default `Generate`). Text changes are picked up; while a loading, success or error label shows, the new label appears when the state ends.
